name: bse-trades-dashboard
description: Chunked BSE trade ingestion with a live dashboard (SSE), built to survive a 30s connection cap on a 15 minute pull.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm -w apps/mock-bse run dev" "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/mock-bse run build && npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/mock-bse run typecheck && npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
